mapper.select: select a.id, a.patient_id, a.reg_date, a.time_range, a.status, a.fee, p.name as patient_name, d.name as doctor_name, dept.name as dept_name from appointment a left join patient p on p.id = a.patient_id left join doctor d on d.id = a.doctor_id left join dept dept on dept.id = d.dept_id where a.id = #{id} and a.tenant_id = #{tenantId}

select a.id, a.patient_id, a.doctor_id, a.reg_date, a.time_range, a.status, a.fee, a.tenant_id from appointment a
order by a.reg_date desc, a.id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select reg_date as reg_date, status as status, count(*) as cnt, coalesce(sum(fee), 0) as total_fee from appointment where tenant_id = #{tenantId} group by reg_date, status order by ${sort} ${order}
